evidence.functional_evidence: initialize, register_agent, post_job, claim_job and submit_work had already landed; after upgrading with an invoke_signed vault-payout fix, review_job approved job 4XALzcMjWXderNEnEjek71ZdpAsRfgKAtPoB7JR4ufj5, emptied vault 9QtHZsVDMXu89MJsffipMq3TXaJz88rKnA9PNWSdpWPL, paid 1_950_000 to the worker and 50_000 as a protocol fee, and set status=Accepted / jobs_completed=1.
evidence.ui_check: The hosted page is the generic IDL console (connect Phantom or Solflare on devnet). It was not driven in headless Chromium in this run; initialize through review_job were sent with the lab wallet through the IDL client in tests/devnet/guild-protocol.mjs.

limitations: cancel_job and top_up_bond were not re-exercised after the upgrade (cancel_job was patched the same way). The lab wallet was poster, worker, reviewer and treasury. A lab patch replaces direct lamport mutation of the system-owned vault with invoke_signed system transfers; the same fix is offered upstream as https://github.com/StackedLines/guild-protocol/pull/1
